scenario: 今天 AI 搜索的主线是把证据找全。一个问题的答案常散在多段、多篇文档里，只找到写着答案的那一段并不够。Perplexity 的上下文 embedding 不再只认一个答案段，把交代上下文的佐证段也排上来。链式检索器拿自己走错过的检索历史来训练，学会从错段里拉回来。DeFT-RAG 每次只问一个写全实体名的子问题，答过的还能复用。覆盖感知选文按子问题挑互相补充的文档。另一条线是少部署一个模型，Glance 让生成模型自己给候选段落排序，省掉单独的 reranker。

papers.title: Contextual Embeddings Beyond the Gold Chunk
papers.authors: Sedigheh Eslami, Markus Krimmel, William Barber, Antoine Chaffin, Maximilian Schall, Jonas Golde, Louis Milliken, Ekaterina Glazkova, Denis Bykov, Bo Wang
papers.abstract: Contextual embeddings represent chunks of a document with respect to the document's global context. These models are typically trained and evaluated under the assumption that a relevant document contains only a single relevant chunk. In this work, we argue that in real-world use cases a retriever should not only find answers spread over several chunks but also surface the evidence needed to verify them. To address this, we introduce pplx-embed-v2-context, a family of contextual embedding models trained by distilling graded chunk-level relevance from a query-aware context compression model. This removes the need for gold-chunk labels and makes the training targets independent of the chunking. We utilize a vision-language backbone for training and release pplx-embed-v2-context in 9B and 0.6B sizes with compatible embedding spaces. On the evaluation side, we introduce two benchmarks that label both the chunks that answer a query and the evidence needed to verify the answer. Context-bench is a controlled diagnostic, and Q2D-Chunk is built from real-world search queries. To encourage further research, we also publish Q2D-Chunk as a public leaderboard. Our 9B model sets a new state of the art on both benchmarks and ConTEB. We find that the visual retrieval capabilities of our 9B model transfer from its vision-language base model and propose to extend chunking to image inputs. We demonstrate that our models achieve state-of-the-art performance among dense retrievers on visual ViDoRe-V3 and that performance improves with granular image chunking.
papers.summary: RAG 把长文档切成小段检索时，回答一个问题往往不只需要写着答案的那一段，还需要交代说的是哪个产品、哪一年的段落。现有的上下文 embedding 训练只认一个标准答案段，同一文档的其余段一律当负例，这些佐证段反而被压低。Perplexity 这篇换了监督来源：让一个能看到 query 的压缩模型给文档里每个 token 打相关度分，一段的分取段内最高几个 token 的平均，embedding 模型去拟合这组有高有低的分数，不再需要标注答案段。在新建的诊断基准上，9B 模型找到答案段的比例比最强基线 voyage-context-4 高 14.4 个点；去掉这一步蒸馏，在真实搜索 query 上找到答案段的比例平均掉 15.2 个点。==段落级的监督怎么给，比换更大的模型更值得先改。==

papers.title: Retrieving from Your Own Mistakes: On-Policy Training of Embedding Models for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Chenjie Qiu, Zixuan Zeng, Shaobin Shi, Bingfeng Chen, Dongsheng Luo, Boyan Xu
papers.abstract: Complex questions in retrieval-augmented generation require evidence spread over several documents, and an answer is reliable only when the retriever finds all of it. Chain embedding retrievers collect such evidence step by step, re-encoding the question together with the passages retrieved so far, and we find that they are already strong: trained only on gold histories, a small chain embedding retriever that calls no language model outperforms graph-based systems and is competitive with a search agent. This training, however, leaves a gap. At test time the retriever conditions on its own retrievals, which soon contain mistakes: by the third step, about half or more of the states it visits hold a wrong passage, and these passages lower its chance of retrieving a missing gold passage well beyond what the difficulty of the states explains. We propose on-policy state training, which trains the encoder on the states it reaches itself. At every epoch the current encoder retrieves chains for the training questions; each state it visits, including those built on its own mistakes, is labeled with the earliest gold passage still missing while the other missing gold passages are masked, so that no correct continuation is penalized; and the encoder is updated contrastively on these states mixed with teacher-forced ones, so that its training distribution follows it as it learns. The resulting retriever retrieves complete evidence more often than teacher-forced training and the systems we compare, and it transfers without further training to harder long-chain variants of HotpotQA and 2WikiMultiHopQA that we construct. On the same states, it recovers from its own mistakes far more often, and controlled comparisons attribute the gain to training on the states the encoder currently reaches.
papers.summary: 多跳检索里的链式 embedding 检索器，训练时看到的检索历史全是正确段落，上线后看到的却是它自己找回来、常常带错的段落。它每一步把问题和已找到的段落拼在一起再找下一段，早先找错一段，后面每一步都带着这个错。在四跳的 MuSiQue 问题上，到第三步时已有 70% 的检索状态混进了错段。作者的办法是每轮训练都让当前模型自己跑一遍，把它真实走到的状态，包括走错的，拿来训练，目标设为还没找到的最早那段正确段落。同样的模型和训练配方下，前五段里把证据找全的问题比例从 44.6% 提到 50.5%。==检索器也有训练和推理时历史不一致的问题，用它自己犯过的错来训练就能补上一部分。==

papers.title: DeFT-RAG: Incrementally Decomposing Multi-Hop Questions into Self-Contained Sub-Questions with Reusable Answers
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) lets a large language model (LLM) answer questions by retrieving relevant passages from a large corpus. However, RAG struggles with multi-hop questions, which require chaining facts spread across several documents through intermediate entities that the question never mentions. Graph-based RAG methods retrieve once from the entities a question names and so rarely recover the full evidence chain. Iterative RAG methods recover it step by step, but their accuracy is limited by the many tasks they ask the LLM to perform, such as planning the sub-questions, deciding their dependencies, rewriting them as answers arrive, and keeping track of what is known. We propose DeFT-RAG, a RAG framework built on three components. First, DeFT-RAG generates one self-contained sub-question at a time from the original question and the sub-questions answered so far with their answers (QA pairs). Each sub-question names every entity it asks about, which removes the need to plan, track dependencies or rewrite, and lets the LLM focus on a single fine-grained task at a time. Second, DeFT-RAG moves the remaining LLM work outside the LLM: rule-based updates to a QA table that keeps track of what is known, and yes/no decisions made by a fine-tuned lightweight decision model. Third, DeFT-RAG caches the QA pairs and reuses an answer when a later question asks a sub-question with the same meaning. On MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA and HotpotQA, DeFT-RAG achieves the best accuracy among thirteen baselines with both gpt-4o-mini and Qwen3.6 as the backbone, while giving the LLM fewer input tokens than any other iterative method. With a QA cache shared across 1,000 MuSiQue questions, 23.1% of sub-questions are answered from the cache, which reduces LLM calls by 12.9% without lowering accuracy.
papers.summary: 多跳问题要靠中间实体一环扣一环地找证据，可问题本身从不提这些中间实体。图检索类 RAG 从问题点到的实体出发，大多只走到第一环，三跳问题里能把整条证据链找全的不到一成。迭代式方法能一步步找，但 LLM 要同时规划、排先后、改写、记账，每件事都会出错。DeFT-RAG 让 LLM 每次只写一个把实体名写全的子问题。答出的子问题连同答案按规则写进问答表，不靠 LLM 记；某段是否相关、已有答案够不够用这类是非判断，交给微调过的小模型。在 1,000 道 MuSiQue 题共享缓存时，23.1% 的子问题直接从缓存作答，LLM 调用少了 12.9%，准确率不降。

papers.title: Decompose, Estimate, Select: Coverage-Aware Context Construction for Long-Form RAG
papers.authors: He Tu, Aleena Bosco Kurumthottam, Torsten Suel
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds a language model's output in retrieved evidence, but for complex questions spanning multiple aspects of an information need, relevance-based retrieval may return redundant evidence while leaving some aspects unsupported. We propose a coverage-aware retrieval pipeline that decomposes queries into subquestions, ranks candidates with a coverage-trained bi-encoder, predicts a document\,$\times$\,subquestion coverage matrix with a cross-encoder, and selects documents by greedy maximum-marginal coverage. On TREC RAG 2024, our approach improves $α$-nDCG@10, which rewards newly covered nuggets and discounts redundant evidence, from $0.625$ to $0.702$, approaching the $0.718$ gold-nugget upper bound without sacrificing relevance. We then find that ground-truth oracle retrieval, despite substantially higher retrieval coverage, delivers no more nugget coverage to the answer than our estimated selection. This suggests that answer completeness depends not only on what evidence is retrieved, but also on how effectively the generator uses it. To address this, we introduce a \emph{grounded self-feedback loop} in which the model identifies underused evidence from its first answer and generates again without gold supervision, raising $V_{\mathrm{strict}}$, the fraction of vital reference nuggets fully supported by the answer, by $0.086$ over two passes while largely preserving faithfulness.
papers.summary: 长答案 RAG 需要的是一组互相补充的文档，而按相关度逐篇打分挑出来的十篇，常常反复讲同一个方面，别的方面没有覆盖。作者先让 LLM 把问题拆成几个子问题，再用一个 cross-encoder 预测每篇文档能回答哪些子问题，然后每次挑一篇能补上最多新子问题的文档。在 TREC RAG 2024 上，α-nDCG 从 0.625 提到 0.702，已接近用人工标注的答案要点来挑时的上限。更有意思的是，用人工标注挑出的文档覆盖得更全，写进答案的要点却并不比它多。==答案完不完整，不只取决于找到了什么，还取决于生成模型有没有用上。==

papers.title: xPRT: Cross-Passage Retrieval Pretraining
papers.authors: Danush Khanna, Himanshu Singhal, Pranjal A. Chitale, Bishal Santra
papers.abstract: Dense retrievers are a foundational component underlying modern RAG and search systems. Training these models typically requires a curated collection of annotated query-document pairs, which are prohibitively expensive to obtain outside a handful of well-resourced domains. This has motivated a line of work that leverages large-scale unsupervised retrieval pretraining from unlabelled text alone. Most such methods learn by optimizing a language modelling or contrastive learning objective over short spans within a document. This raises the question: how can we extract richer learning signals from a single document for retrieval pretraining? To address it, we introduce xPRT (Cross-Passage Retrieval Pretraining), an unsupervised framework that learns from the key information distributed across an entire document and the connections between its parts. We evaluate xPRT against five state-of-the-art objectives on MTEB English v2, continuing pretraining from a public unsupervised checkpoint while holding the corpus, schedule, and training procedure fixed. Across diverse tasks spanning all task types, we observe that xPRT consistently outperforms the strongest baseline by 3.2% on an average. Notably, in this continual pretraining setting, many baseline methods incur substantial performance regressions, whereas our method delivers the largest complementary gains over the initial pretrained checkpoint. Controlled ablations confirm that xPRT's performance gains stem from its proposed cross-passage signals. xPRT demonstrates that a single unlabelled document is a much richer source of retrieval signal than prior work assumed and offers complementary gains to what current retrievers already capture.
papers.summary: 一篇没有标注的网页里，哪几段在讲相关的事，本身就能拿来训练检索模型。xPRT 的做法是：先挑出向量最接近全文平均向量的段落，作为这篇文档的代表段；再按向量相似度和词面重合，找出文档里和它最相关的四段；然后把这几段的大部分词遮住，只给一个单层的小解码器加上代表段的向量，让它把被遮的词补回来，逼着这个向量装下相关段的内容。作者在已做过大规模对比预训练的 E5 上继续预训练，语料和训练流程固定、只换目标：五种已有方法在 MTEB 上最多涨 0.4 分，多数还跌到起点以下，xPRT 稳定涨 1.8 到 1.9 分。把挑出的相关段换成同一文档里随机的一段，收益就没了，因为网页里混着导航和链接列表。

papers.title: Glance: The Generator Is Its Own Reranker
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation commonly serves separate models for reranking and answering, duplicating model residency and passage processing. We introduce Glance, which equips the generator with a lightweight decision adapter and pointer head to score candidate passages from a shared prefill. Short relevance probes branch from the cached context, producing one score per passage without separately prefilling each query-passage pair. A single resident 9B backbone supports generation, general decisions and reranking, with approximately 0.1 GiB of additional memory per decision skill. After 39 minutes of MS MARCO fine-tuning, Glance achieves nDCG@10 of 0.741 on SciFact and 0.345 on NFCorpus, compared with 0.721 and 0.326 for bge-reranker-v2-m3. On 300 HotpotQA questions, its selected context improves answer F1 by 0.045 over cross-encoder-selected context under the same base generator (paired bootstrap 95% CI [0.014, 0.076]). In a scaling study, reranking quality keeps rising up to 200 candidates (43k tokens) scored from one shared prefill, where it exceeds the cross-encoder by 0.058 nDCG@10, and a probe-only activated adapter lets generation continue from the original passage cache. These initial results demonstrate generator-based reranking with one resident backbone; evaluation currently covers two retrieval datasets, one QA dataset and one backbone family.
papers.summary: RAG 系统通常要同时部署一个 reranker 和一个生成模型，候选段落被两个模型各读一遍。Glance 的思路是：生成模型反正要读这些段落，不如让它自己来排序。它把所有候选段落一次 prefill 进 KV cache，再从这份共享缓存上给每段接一小段打分提示，由一组 LoRA 参数和一个打分头给出相关度，然后同一个模型接着生成答案，每多一种判断能力只多占约 0.1 GiB 显存。在 MS MARCO 上短暂微调后，它在 SciFact 上的 nDCG@10 是 0.741，专用 reranker bge-reranker-v2-m3 是 0.721。评测只覆盖两个检索集和一个模型家族，但少部署一个常驻模型，对服务成本的影响很直接。

papers.title: How Specific Do I Need to Be? Effects of User Query Underspecification on Deep Research Agents
papers.authors: Yi Wen, Xiangjue Dong, Bingxuan Li, Hangxiao Zhu, Leo Zhicheng Liu, Yu Zhang, James Caverlee
papers.abstract: Deep research agents (DRAs) conduct long-horizon reasoning, search, and literature synthesis to provide long-form answers to complex, domain-specific questions. These agents are typically trained and evaluated on fully specified user queries. However, real-world user queries can often be underspecified. We introduce UNDERSPEC-DR, a framework for systematically evaluating how underspecified queries affect agents' final answer quality and intermediate search behavior. Across three DRAs we evaluated, underspecification substantially reduces how well DRA's answers fulfill users' information needs, even though they remain grounded in cited evidence. Our analysis of intermediate search behavior suggests a possible explanation: DRAs conduct broader searches that draw less on the original user query but rely more on their learned prior during training, which can be misaligned with users' intent. Our findings reveal the vulnerability of current DRAs to underspecified user queries and inform future efforts to build DRAs that proactively recognize when additional user input is needed to reliably complete deep research tasks.
papers.summary: 用户向深度研究 agent 提问时，常常没说清时间范围、用错专业术语，或者没提自己的偏好。作者把完整问题里的这类信息逐项删掉或说得含糊，在三个深度研究 agent 上对比答案。少了范围或术语时，答案对用户真实需求的覆盖明显下降，但引用依旧准确，并没有更多幻觉。搜索过程给出了原因：问题一含糊，agent 搜得更广，搜索词里来自用户原话的部分变少，更多来自模型训练时学到的东西。专门为深度研究训练、完整问题上得分更高的 agent，掉得反而更多。==深度研究 agent 需要学会在问题不清楚时先问一句，而不是自己猜。==

papers.title: Relevance-Guided Residual Calibration for Spectral Compression of Dense Retrieval Embeddings
papers.authors: Yongkang Li, Panagiotis Eustratiadis, Evangelos Kanoulas
papers.abstract: Spectral compression reduces the storage and scoring costs of dense retrieval by projecting embeddings onto a smaller principal subspace. However, its corpus-derived weighting rules tie all retained directions to a shared spectral trend, without directly accounting for their individual contributions to relevance. To address this, we propose Relevance-Guided Residual Calibration (RRC), a closed-form method for refining spectral weights using relevance judgments. RRC estimates margin-based weights from the means and variances of positive--negative score contributions along each retained direction. It retains directions with positive estimated weights, decomposes their log weights into a fitted power-law trend and a residual, and adds the residual to the compressor's log weights on this support. This allows relevance judgments to adjust individual directions while preserving the compressor's overall spectral trend. RRC applies to PCA, Whitening, and SpecTemp, and incorporates the corrections into the existing transformation shared by documents and queries, without iterative model training or an additional inference stage. Experiments with three encoders on nine datasets covering conventional and reasoning-intensive retrieval show that SpecTemp + RRC achieves the highest mean effectiveness among tested compressors on the BEIR group and BRIGHT at every target dimension. On the five evaluated BRIGHT datasets, it improves over SpecTemp by an average of 2.34 nDCG@10 points at 768 dimensions. The gains also persist under scalar and product quantization, improving the trade-off between per-document storage and retrieval effectiveness. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rrc-spectral-compression-B5CE/
papers.summary: 把检索 embedding 投影到少数几个主方向上，是压缩存储和打分开销的常用办法，但每个方向保留多大权重，只看语料统计出的整体趋势，不看它对区分相关和不相关文档有多大用。RRC 用相关性标注重新估计每个方向的权重：某个方向对相关和不相关文档的得分差贡献平均越大、波动越小，权重就越高。它再用一条幂律曲线拟合这些权重的整体走势，只把每个方向偏离曲线的那部分加到原有权重上，原来大方向权重高、小方向权重低的走势不变。它只改 query 和文档共用的那个线性变换，不用训练模型，也不加推理步骤。在推理密集的 BRIGHT 基准的五个数据集上，压到 768 维时，nDCG@10 比原来的压缩方法 SpecTemp 平均高 2.34 个点，再做量化收益依旧在。

papers.title: Quantum-Inspired Pairwise Ranking Aggregation via Active LLM Feedback
papers.authors: Quan Mai, Susan Gauch, Gibson Nkhata
papers.abstract: Ranking aggregation from multiple retrievers is a powerful yet under-explored technique in modern retrieval and RAG systems. We introduce LLM-IRA, the first extension of the quantum-inspired interactive ranking aggregation framework to document reranking. By leveraging large language models (LLMs) solely for pairwise judgments on high-disagreement document pairs, our method learns fusion weights in a principled, interactive way. The final ranking is a simple, ultra-fast pointwise linear fusion of scores, no full pairwise matrix or expensive listwise prompting is required. Experiments on the BEIR benchmark and TREC Deep Learning tracks with an open-weight instruction-tuned judge (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) show that LLM-IRA matches or numerically exceeds strong static fusion baselines on 5 of 6 evaluated benchmarks. We report two weight-update variants: momentum blending and a full accumulated-history refit, which together reach statistical significance (Wilcoxon signed-rank, p<0.05) over the best unsupervised aggregator on 4 of 6 benchmarks (DL19 under momentum; DL20, DBpedia, and NFCorpus under accumulated refit, which is the stronger of the two configurations overall). On the benchmarks we profiled (DL19, DL20), it already clears the best unsupervised baseline within as few as 5 LLM calls per query, well before exhausting its typical ~25--30 call budget. LLM-IRA also achieves cost-effectiveness comparable to state-of-the-art zero-shot LLM rerankers at an order of magnitude fewer LLM calls, and requires no training data or model fine-tuning.
papers.summary: 融合多路检索结果时，RRF 这类无监督方法便宜但不会学习，用 LLM 做列表式重排效果好，每个 query 却要调用上百次。LLM-IRA 走中间路线：只挑几路检索器意见分歧最大的文档对，让 LLM 判断哪篇更相关，用这些判断去学各路检索器的融合权重，最后的排序仍是简单的线性加权打分。作者用一个 8B 开源指令模型当裁判，在多数基准上持平或超过最好的静态融合方法；在两届 TREC DL 上，每个 query 只要约 5 次 LLM 调用就已超过最好的无监督融合。它不需要训练数据，也不用微调模型，适合只想在融合层花少量 LLM 预算的场景。

papers.title: Feedback-Assisted Trust Propagation over Document Relation Graphs for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems rely on external corpora that may contain outdated, contradictory, noisy, or unreliable documents, introducing reliability risks. Prior work has leveraged document relations to improve the answer reliability of RAG. To propagate reliability signals beyond directly compared document pairs, we propose TrustPropRAG, which structures document relations as a graph and estimates document reliability through multi-hop propagation across the graph. TrustPropRAG anchors this propagation with a limited set of human feedback on document reliability, extending these costly-to-collect feedback-based reliability signals across the whole corpus. Specifically, based on the constructed document relation graph, TrustPropRAG estimates a trust score for each document by formulating and solving an optimization problem that jointly captures pairwise document relations and user feedback. These scores are then used to improve the selection of reliable documents and support trust-aware answer generation. Evaluation results show that TrustPropRAG improves both retrieval quality and exact match over baselines, and remains robust under sparse and noisy feedback.
papers.summary: RAG 的语料里常混着过期、互相矛盾或不可靠的文档，人工标注哪篇可信又很贵，只能覆盖一小部分。这篇的办法是把每篇文档当作图上的一个点：两篇来自同一来源、互相支持或互相矛盾，就连一条边，这些关系可以用 NLI 模型判断。人工只给少数单篇文档标出可不可信。它再求解一个优化问题，一部分要求各篇的可信度分和边上的关系对得上，一部分要求贴合人工反馈，这样可信度就从少数标过的文档传到全库。检索和生成答案时都参考这个分数。作者报告检索质量和 EM 都优于基线，反馈稀少或带噪时依旧稳定。
